parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region in which the data lake resides.

parameters.name: IfNotExists
parameters.description:
If the new partition name duplicates an existing partition name, ignore the exception. Values:

- true: Ignore.

- false: Do not ignore.

parameters.name: NeedResult
parameters.description: Return partition information. If set to true, the Partitions field is returned.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
Tenant ID.

> To view the tenant ID, hover over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
